#1 Bay Area Bar Mitzvah DJ & Bat Mitzvah Entertainment

 

High-Energy, Authentic Jewish Celebrations in San Francisco, San Jose, & All of Northern California

  Are you planning a milestone Bar Mitzvah or Bat Mitzvah in Northern California? At California Disc Jockey, we understand that this is far more than just a party—it is a sacred coming-of-age transition. As the premier Bay Area Bar Mitzvah DJ, we specialize in blending deep-rooted Jewish traditions with high-octane, modern entertainment to create an unforgettable, high-energy experience for your child, family, and friends.

Ready to Plan an Unforgettable Simcha?

📞 Call DJ Chris Toll-Free: 1-415-350-5474

☎ Direct & Emergency Line: 415-350-5474

⚡ Emergency Party Planning Available: Had another DJ let you down? Need to organize an event quickly? Call us immediately—stop worrying, we have you covered!

Why Choose California Disc Jockey for Your Family’s Simcha?

With over 18 years of experience serving Bay Area Jewish families, we bring an elite level of expertise that rookie DJs simply cannot match. We have proudly served premier regional venues, including Temple Emanu-El, Temple Beth Shalom, and the JCC San Rafael (Jewish Community Center).
Expert DJ, MC & Motivators Our seasoned Northern California entertainers keep every single guest engaged — from the youngest cousins on the dance floor to the grandparents. We never send rookies to your milestone celebration.
Customized Playlists We collaborate directly with the Guest of Honor to design a soundtrack that reflects their unique personality — from Sabrina Carpenter and Travis Scott to timeless classics.
Seamless Digital Planning Our free online timeline planner lets you effortlessly coordinate every cue, from the Grand Entrance and Hora to the Candle Lighting ceremony and the last dance.
State-of-the-Art Production Premium sound systems, club-style lighting, professional laser light shows, interactive photo booths, LED dance floors, and video projection for a fully immersive environment.

Contact Us for References & Availability

JCC San Rafael Jewish Community Center — The Hora Chair

🎵 The Ultimate Bar Mitzvah & Bat Mitzvah Soundtrack

We don’t just play music — we curate an atmosphere. Our expert Bar and Bat Mitzvah DJs are masters of the seamless live mix, ensuring every transition from the formal cocktail hour to a packed dance floor is flawless.

🔥 Modern Chart-Toppers, Rap & Viral Hits

We stay ahead of the trends to keep the kids thrilled with clean edits of artists like: Sabrina Carpenter, Taylor Swift, Jack Harlow, SZA, Drake, Harry Styles, Travis Scott, Bruno Mars, Miley Cyrus, Dua Lipa, and The Weeknd.

⏪ Timeless Throwbacks for All Generations

  • 70s & 80s — Disco Fever, Classic Rock, Motown, Big Band, and New Wave Pop
  • 90s & 2000s — Classic Hip-Hop, R&B, and Throwback Anthems

💃 Interactive Party Anthems

Tracks that bring every generation together: Cupid Shuffle, Cha Cha Slide, Electric Slide, Macarena, YMCA, I Gotta Feeling, Locomotion, New York New York, and more.

✡️ Authentic Hebrew & Israeli Classics

We honor your heritage with spirit and soul, featuring classics such as: Hava Nagila, Siman Tov U’Mazal Tov, David Melech, Hevenu Shalom, Tzena Tzena, Yerushalaim, Mayim Dance, and To Life (L’Chaim).

✡️ Authentic Jewish Tradition: The Traditional Hora & Simcha Songlist

The Hora Chair Dance is the iconic circle dance and the emotional highlight of every Simcha. We ensure your family is safely and energetically lifted with a deep repertoire of traditional music, including:

Traditional Hora & Simcha Songlist

  • Hava Nagila
  • David Melech
  • Tzena Tzena
  • Siman Tov U’Mazal Tov
  • Hevenu Shalom
  • Hine Ma Tov
  • Zemer Atik
  • Mayim Dance
  • To Life
  • Yerushalaim
  • Yismehu
  • Happy Birthday / Yom Huledet
  • Hayom Yom Huledet
  • Tumbalalaika
  • Le Kova Sheli
  • Pata Pata
  • Tzur Moshelo
  • Tzadik Katamar
  • Haroah Kakatana
  • Rona Sheli

Interactive Games & Low-Cheese, High-Fun Group Participation

We specialize in high-energy engagement without the corny gimmicks. Whether you want an explosive, club-style dance floor or a sophisticated, low-key vibe, we tailor our style to your family’s specific wishes.
  • Classic & Modern Dances: From the Cha Cha Slide and Cupid Shuffle to TikTok-inspired dance-offs.
  • Engaging Games: Scavenger Hunts, Musical Chairs, Name That Song, Battle of the Bands, Silly Dance Contests, and competitions complete with prizes.
  • Group Participation (Optional): YMCA, Macarena, Chicken Dance, Electric Slide, I Gotta Feeling, Locomotion, New York New York.
  • Party Favors & Premium Props: LED necklaces, glow sticks, custom baseball hats, blow-up guitars and saxophones, blinkies, confetti, gangsta hats, maracas, and noise makers.

Your Custom Bar Mitzvah Event Timeline

We help you manage and produce every moment so you can relax and enjoy the evening entirely stress-free:
  1. B’nai Mitzvah Ceremony — Professional audio support for the Torah reading and speech at the synagogue.
  2. Cocktail Hour — Sophisticated background music (Jazz, Ballroom, or Chill Pop).
  3. Grand Entrance — High-energy introductions for the family and the Guest of Honor.
  4. Dancing & Interactive Games — The DJ & MC team instantly set a high-energy tone.
  5. The Hora Chair Dance — The traditional centerpiece circle dance celebration.
  6. Traditional Blessings — Flawless wireless microphone setups for Hamotzi (bread) & Hagafen (wine).
  7. Dinner & Toasts — Crystal-clear audio coverage for family speeches and slide shows.
  8. Candle Lighting Ceremony — Smooth musical tracking for the 13 traditional candle tributes.
  9. Open Dance Floor — A packed floor of family and friends celebrating until the very last song.

Enhance Your Event: Premium Add-On Production Packages

Make your celebration stand out with our high-end audio, visual, and lighting upgrades:
💡 LED Wireless Uplighting: Transform your venue walls with vibrant, custom color schemes.
📸 Interactive Photo Booths: High-quality instant prints and modern digital keepsakes for your guests.
🪩 LED Dance Floors: The ultimate visual centerpiece for a high-energy, modern party.
✨ Cold Sparklers & Low-Lying Fog: Safe, jaw-dropping special effects for the Grand Entrance or the Hora.
🎥 Video Projection Systems: Create an immersive visual environment all night long for montages and graphics.
🎤 Laser Light Shows: Concert-grade professional sound and intelligent club lighting design.

Serving All of Northern California & the SF Bay Area

Based in the heart of the region, California Disc Jockey provides top-tier Mitzvah entertainment across these major areas:

📍 San Francisco & The Peninsula

San Francisco, Burlingame, San Mateo, Palo Alto, Redwood City, Menlo Park, Foster City, San Carlos, Belmont, Millbrae, Woodside, and Atherton.

📍 South Bay

San Jose, Santa Clara, Saratoga, Los Altos, Sunnyvale, Cupertino, Mountain View, Los Gatos, and Milpitas.

📍 East Bay

Oakland, Berkeley, Walnut Creek, Moraga, Fremont, Hayward, Concord, Richmond, Livermore, Pleasanton, Orinda, Lafayette, and Piedmont.

📍 North Bay

Marin County, Napa, Sonoma, San Rafael, Santa Rosa, Petaluma, Novato, Vallejo, and Vacaville.

📍 Destination Events

Sacramento, Lake Tahoe, Santa Cruz, and Monterey.

Bar Mitzvah in San Rafael — California Disc Jockey

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Why choose California Disc Jockey for Bar/Bat Mitzvahs?

We provide premium, high-energy, and deeply interactive DJ & MC services backed by over 18 years of specialized experience in the San Francisco Bay Area. Our team understands how to perfectly balance sacred Jewish traditions — like the Hora and Candle Lighting ceremonies — with modern, interactive games that engage kids and adults alike.

What exactly is included in your Mitzvah packages?

We provide complete, end-to-end entertainment ecosystems:
  • Professional DJ & MC teams playing custom, curated music playlists (Jewish, Pop, Rap, Dance, Throwbacks)
  • Interactive games and group dances (Musical Chairs, Dance-offs, Cha Cha Slide)
  • Full event timeline planning, coordination, and wireless microphones for speeches
  • Optional high-end production: Interactive Photo Booths, LED Dance Floors, and Uplighting Packages

Do your DJs genuinely understand Jewish traditions?

Absolutely. We are seasoned experts in the proper flow of a traditional Simcha. We track the traditional blessings, manage the energy of the Hora, coordinate the Candle Lighting, and have spent years serving congregations like Temple Emanu-El, Temple Beth Shalom, and the JCC San Rafael.

Can you accommodate last-minute or emergency bookings?

Yes. If you have been let down by another entertainment provider or need to organize a last-minute celebration, call our Emergency Party Support line directly at 415-350-5474.

What other types of events do you service?

While we are premier Mitzvah specialists, our team of high-quality, classy Bay Area DJs is also highly sought after for:
  • Weddings & Marriage Celebrations (Serving Alameda, San Mateo, Contra Costa, Napa, Sonoma, Solano, San Jose, Monterey, and Santa Cruz)
  • Festivals & Corporate Picnics / Corporate Events
  • School Dances, Junior High, High School & Graduation Parties
  • Quinceañeras, Birthdays, Anniversaries, and New Year’s Eve Parties
  • Multicultural Events (Bilingual DJ, Jewish Latin, Jewish Indian, Jewish Asian, and Israeli Music Specialties)
  • Karaoke Parties
